title: Scoreboard class with two teams
statement: Define a Scoreboard class with a parameterless constructor that starts 0 to 0, an AddHome method, an AddAway method and a Difference method that returns the home points minus the away points. Read how many points to add to each team, create the object, add that many times to each and write the final difference.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
